_about: Import the products thread's catalog into site/content/shop.json and make small card images. Generated by tools/import_shop.py; edit url/etsy_url here, everything else in the products thread's files.

items.name: The Bill Cut Kit
items.blurb: Find every recurring charge in 10 minutes, cut what you don't use, and lower the bills you keep with word-for-word scripts.

items.name: The 20-Minute Budget
items.blurb: A budget you set up once in an evening and run in 20 minutes a week. 14-page guide + spreadsheet with a debt payoff planner.

items.name: The Credit Report Audit Kit
items.blurb: Read all three credit reports like an auditor, dispute errors with ready-to-send letters, and freeze your credit. No credit repair company needed.

items.name: The Debt-Free Date Planner
items.blurb: Enter your debts, pick avalanche, snowball or your own order, and get the month you'll be debt-free. Plus balance transfer and consolidation calculators.

items.name: Start Investing With $100 a Month
items.blurb: Which account to open first, what to buy, what fees cost, and how to automate it. No stock picks, no hype. Guide + 6 calculators.

items.name: The Money Made Simple Toolkit
items.blurb: All five Money Made Simple kits in one download: Bill Cut, 20-Minute Budget, Credit Report Audit, Debt-Free Date Planner, and Start Investing With $100 a Month. $62 separately, $39 together.

items.name: Monthly Budget Sheet
items.blurb: Plan every dollar, log what you spend, and see each category against its budget. Google Sheets or Excel.

items.name: Debt Payoff Sheet
items.blurb: See your debt-free date by snowball or avalanche, then log payments and watch every balance fall.

items.name: Savings Goals Sheet
items.blurb: Every goal, sinking fund and your emergency fund in one sheet, with what to save each month.

items.name: Money Sheets Bundle
items.blurb: All three Money Made Simple sheets: budget, debt payoff and savings goals. $28 separately, $19 together.

items.name: Notion Budget Planner
items.blurb: Plan every dollar in Notion. Log transactions and every category updates: this month, last month, left.

items.name: Notion Debt Payoff Tracker
items.blurb: Every debt with its balance, payoff date and progress bar. Avalanche and Snowball views tell you what to pay next.

items.name: Notion Savings Goals Tracker
items.blurb: Goals and sinking funds with progress bars, deposits, and how much to save each month to hit each date.

items.name: Notion Money HQ
items.blurb: Budget, debt payoff and savings goals in one Notion home, plus a weekly money check-in. $28 separately, $19 together.

items.name: Notion Money Starter
items.blurb: A free, simple start: one month's budget, one savings goal and a 10-minute weekly check-in.

items.name: Monthly Budget Planner
items.blurb: A simple monthly budget you'll actually keep. One page per month: income, bills, savings, what's left to spend, and a 5-minute weekly check-in.

items.name: Paycheck Budget Planner
items.blurb: Paid every two weeks? Budget each paycheck instead of each month. Every check gets a job: bills due before the next payday, savings, then spending money.

items.name: Savings Challenge
items.blurb: Colour a circle every time you save. Four challenges, $500, $1,000, $2,500 and $5,000, and every set of circles adds up to exactly the goal.

items.name: 52 Week Savings Challenge
items.blurb: Save $1 in week one and $52 in week 52, and finish with $1,378. Or flip it, or set your own weekly amount.

items.name: Bill Tracker
items.blurb: Never miss a due date again. One list of every bill, a 12-month checklist to tick as you pay, a bill calendar and a page for the once-a-year bills that usually sneak up on you.

items.name: Sinking Funds Tracker
items.blurb: Stop being surprised by costs you knew were coming. Set money aside every month for car repairs, gifts, travel and more, and watch each fund fill up.

items.name: Debt Payoff Tracker
items.blurb: Make paying off debt visible. Colour in a square, a step or a line every time your balance drops, and stick it on the fridge.

items.name: Expense Tracker
items.blurb: See where your money actually goes. Log spending as you go (or once a day from your banking app), then total it by category at month end.

items.name: No Spend Challenge
items.blurb: Thirty days of noticing your spending. Set your own rules, colour a circle for every no-spend day, and send what you didn't spend to savings.

items.name: Subscription Tracker
items.blurb: Find every subscription you're paying for, see what each one costs per year, and decide which to keep. Then log each cancellation so it stays cancelled.

items.name: Budget Binder Bundle
items.blurb: The 10 core budget printables in one download: a complete budget binder for less than half the price of buying them one by one.

items.name: 100 Envelope Challenge
items.blurb: The viral savings challenge, on paper. 100 numbered envelopes, $1 to $100: colour one when you save it, and the full chart adds up to exactly $5,050.

items.name: Biweekly Savings Challenge
items.blurb: Paid every two weeks? Save the same amount from all 26 paychecks. Pick your goal ($520 to $5,200) and tick each check off.

items.name: 30 Day Savings Challenge
items.blurb: A quick win: save $100, $250 or $500 in 30 days. One circle a day, mixed amounts, and every set adds up to exactly its goal.

items.name: Dice Savings Challenge
items.blurb: Make saving a game: roll a die once a week and save $5 (or $10) times the number. 52 weeks, a surprise every week.

items.name: Savings Jar Tracker
items.blurb: Colour the jar up as you save. Each line is 5% of your goal, with a log beside it for every coin, round-up and skipped coffee.

items.name: Savings Bingo
items.blurb: Bingo, but every square is money saved. Colour squares as you save them, earn a small reward for every line, and fill the card to hit exactly $1,000 or $2,000.

items.name: Vacation Savings Tracker
items.blurb: Save for the trip without the credit card hangover. Budget the trip, then stamp a passport page as the fund fills, with a countdown to departure.

items.name: Emergency Fund Tracker
items.blurb: Work out what your emergency fund needs to be, then fill 60 squares to six months of essentials, with milestones from a starter fund to 6 months.

items.name: Down Payment Savings Tracker
items.blurb: Build your house one brick at a time: 100 bricks, each worth 1% of your home fund. A costs page makes sure you're saving for the real total.

items.name: Holiday Savings Planner
items.blurb: Pay for the holidays before they arrive. Plan the season's spending, divide by the months left, and save a little every month.

items.name: Weekly Budget Planner
items.blurb: Budget one week at a time: money in, bills due, a spending limit, and a column for each day.

items.name: Zero Based Budget Worksheet
items.blurb: Give every dollar a job: income at the top, eight sections below, and a check box that hits zero when you're done.

items.name: 50 30 20 Budget Worksheet
items.blurb: The simplest budget there is: needs, wants and savings. Work out your three targets and see your real split.

items.name: Cash Envelope Tracker
items.blurb: The envelope system on paper: 16 envelope cards with a budget and running balance, plus a cash plan to break each into notes.

items.name: Daily Spending Tracker
items.blurb: Thirty seconds a night: what you spent, need or want, and a running total against your monthly limit.

items.name: Grocery Budget Tracker
items.blurb: Groceries are the budget line you can change this week. Set a weekly number, plan meals, shop from the list, log receipts.

items.name: Irregular Income Budget
items.blurb: For freelancers, gig workers and anyone whose pay changes: a baseline budget, an income log, and four buckets to fill in order.

items.name: Utility Bill Tracker
items.blurb: See what electric, gas, water, internet and phone cost each month, and spot a jump before it becomes a habit.

items.name: Car Expense Tracker
items.blurb: What does your car really cost a month? Fuel, service and yearly costs in one place, added up to a true monthly number.

items.name: Financial Goals Planner
items.blurb: Turn 'sort my money out' into three goals with an amount, a date, a monthly number and first steps.

items.name: Net Worth Tracker
items.blurb: One number that shows if you're moving forward: what you own minus what you owe. Snapshot it, log it and plot it.

items.name: Monthly Money Review
items.blurb: Twenty minutes at month end: the numbers, your wins, what surprised you, and one change for next month.

items.name: Credit Card Payoff Tracker
items.blurb: One block per card: balance, APR, minimum, 30 squares to colour and a payment log. Four cards across two pages.

items.name: Debt Snowball Worksheet
items.blurb: Plan the payoff order, snowball or avalanche, and write out exactly where each paid-off debt's payment rolls next.

items.name: Debt Coloring Chart
items.blurb: Climb your debt mountain: 100 blocks, each 1% of the debt, from a wide base to the debt-free summit flag.

items.name: Loan Payoff Tracker
items.blurb: For a car, student or personal loan: colour one box per payment, log extra payments, and watch the payoff date move up.

items.name: Savings Account Register
items.blurb: A simple ledger for a savings account or a single goal: deposits, withdrawals, interest and balance.

items.name: Checking Account Register
items.blurb: Know your real balance. Log payments, deposits and autopays, then tick each one off against your banking app weekly.

items.name: Gift Budget Planner
items.blurb: Every birthday, holiday and wedding gift for the year in one list, with a budget per gift and a monthly amount to save.

items.name: Side Hustle Income Tracker
items.blurb: Know what your side hustle really makes: income by source, costs, profit and tax set aside, month by month.

items.name: Savings Challenge Bundle
items.blurb: Every savings challenge in the shop in one download: twelve ways to make saving a habit (and a bit of a game).

items.name: Mega Budget Planner Bundle
items.blurb: Every printable in the shop, 40 of them, in one download: budgets, bills, savings challenges, debt trackers and money records.

items.name: Debt Payoff Bundle
items.blurb: The five debt printables in one download: a payoff tracker for each credit card and loan, a snowball worksheet, and two charts to colour in as the balance falls.

items.name: First Paycheck Budget Bundle
items.blurb: Six printables for your first real paychecks: give each paycheck a job, try the 50/30/20 split, track bills and spending, and write down what you're saving for.

items.name: Freelance Budget Bundle
items.blurb: Seven printables for uneven income: pay yourself a steady amount, log side-hustle income, track expenses and bills, fill sinking funds and an emergency fund, and review each month.
